title: Peers come and go without a gap; output latency is compensated, with a manual offset
description:
As a performer, I want Apricity to keep going when peers come and go, and to sound on the beat through my speakers, so that a crash in another app or a slow audio interface doesn't knock me out of time.

Spec file: `features/link/play.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: Peers come and go; the output is on the beat

  Scenario: The DAW leaves
    Given the score plays in a Link session at 124 BPM with 1 other peer
    When that peer leaves
    Then Apricity keeps playing at 124 BPM on the same beat
    And it prints "Link: no other peers; keeping 124 BPM"

  Scenario: A peer joins while Apricity plays
    Given the score plays alone in a Link session at 100 BPM
    When a peer joins
    Then it prints "Link: 1 peer, 100 BPM"
    And Apricity keeps playing without a gap

  Scenario: Output latency is compensated
    Given the audio device reports 12 ms of output latency
    When the score plays in a Link session
    Then each click leaves the device on the session's beat within the tolerance, not 12 ms late

  Scenario: A manual latency offset
    Given the score plays in a Link session with "--latency 20"
    Then every click leaves the device 20 ms earlier than it would without the offset
```
